blocks.text: By taking charge of a nation that has made just one major tournament in the past 30 years and is ranked 105th by FIFA, you could make the case that Alen Stajcic is on the back nine of his coaching career. But the way the former Matildas boss sees it, his appointment as head coach of Indonesia’s women’s national team is the furthest thing from slowing down. Stajcic, handed the role last week on a three-year deal that runs until the 2029 Asian Cup in Uzbekistan, has the chance to lift Australia’s nearest neighbours in Asian football to new heights from […]...
